profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Edgecast | AI-Assisted Development
profile.summary: One of the styles of programming is modularization. Much like that, I recognize the fact that to achieve something truly great everyone must contribute in some way. This is the mentality I bring to my career and I hope to become a leader within the industry so I can better implement my ideas.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and delivered a full-stack livestreaming platform supporting real-time video, VOD recording, viewer analytics, and push notifications using Tencent Cloud integration                                                         
  - Built pay-per-view monetization system with Kyvo (payment provider) integration, enabling creators to monetize premium content with earnings tracking                                                                                     
  - Developed identity and social platform backend (Python/FastAPI) including communities, user feeds, social graph (follow/block/mute), and badge systems                                                                                    
  - Designed async database layer with repository pattern using SQLAlchemy and Alembic, improving API performance and establishing scalable architecture patterns
  - Leading active migration of PHP/Laravel social API to Go, porting 20+ routes including SPA routing, event ingestion, settings, and metrics endpoints using Chi router
  - Built cross-domain media processing pipeline with dedicated Go worker pod handling story image/video processing, HEIC conversion, and stale-job recovery
  - Implemented IDP token-swap proxy with server-side bearer resolution and OAuth token refresh persistence, enabling cross-app authentication and linked-account switching
  - Built incremental web client in React (post detail, profiles, search, realtime notifications, DM inbox) across 6+ sequential PRs
  - Led infrastructure security initiatives including domain migrations, alerting systems, and WAF configuration tooling (Go)
  - Leveraged AI pair programming to accelerate development velocity, delivering 800+ commits across Python, Go, PHP, React, and React Native codebases
positions.insights: Skills: AI-Assisted Development · FastAPI · Laravel · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
* Implementing Oauth authorization and authentication at web server layer
* Adjusting security APIs to rapidly evolving business need surrounding merging of two platforms
* Migrating Security APIs to Oauth 3.0 spec and implementing in AWS API Gateway
* Helped team add configuration versioning system and API using AWS RDS, Golang, Redis, and NGINX
* Adding additional functionality to legacy MVC framework in C#

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
* Working on back office security features using Golang and Python
* Managing end-to-end workflow from back office to front end UI
* Adding public and private APIs to aid development and enhance user experience

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
* Designing, testing and releasing new features to .Net Web Application based on business and stakeholder needs.
* Implementing billing and tiering systems for different products
* Migrating customers from old version of features to new version in as seamless a way as possible

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
• Feature development for security products with an emphasis on ASP.NET Web API and MVC.
• Maintain and refactor legacy code including WCF Services, and ASP.Net Webforms.
• Contribute to automation test base and automation framework
• Perform code reviews and coach team on best practices.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
• SME of customer security feature on .NET web app
• Implement new web app features based on business objectives
• Write automation tests for new customer facing features developed
• Contribute new features to automation framework to solve global scope issues and facilitate test writing for other SDETs
• Share knowledge and expertise with other team members via demos, presentations, and code reviews
• Assist in building automation frameworks for new microservices

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Maintain assigned feature tests in C# automation framework.
• Write new API tests in C#/Nunit framework
• Contribute to .NET  Web App codebase
• Help facilitate daily deployment to production

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Add new API tests to Javascript automation suite and future-proof existing tests.
•	Write and maintain suite of automated functional testing in python to facilitate end-to-end automation of security features in product.
•       Contribute new automated Selenium UI tests and future proof existing ones using python-based framework and sauce labs.
•	Participate in daily deployment process.
•	Embedded QA resource in two agile pods.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Contribute to construction of new automation framework to be used as part of continuous integration testing automation (CI/TA) for software builds. 
•	Create, manage, and run build jobs on Jenkins server.
•	Write automation tests using selenium, Java, TestNG and page object model.
•	Leverage product APIs to set up test data.
•	Contributed to automation of AWS EC2/RDB environments using the AWS SDK/APIs in Java.
•	Contribute to automated product installation scripts for use with the automation framework.
•	Adapt SOAP UI test suites to new automation framework.
•	Set up environment VMs, databases, and contribute to knowledgebase.
•	Team uses scrum approach to development using JIRA agile board.

positions.title: Support Analyst
positions.description:
•	Resolve technical product support tickets by using a variety of technologies including but not limited to: WS-Security, SOAP, REST, ORACLE DB, MySql, XML, and Java.
•	Help customer configure their environments by running load tests and bug recreation scenarios. 
•	Facilitate communication to and between QA and Engineering. 
•	Contribute technical documents to company knowledgebase.

positions.title: Vice National Student Representative
positions.description: Help plan and coordinate national events and manage national programs and documents.

company.name: MAES: Latinos in Science and Engineering

positions.title: Co-President
positions.description: Manage logistics for all events and meetings. Help raise funds for chapter. Maintain contacts with Industry.

company.name: Society of Mexican-American Engineers and Scientists, Long Beach Chapter

projects.title: RecipeMix
projects.description: RecipeMix is a comprehensive meal planning and management service that was created as a senior capstone project for CECS 423 at California State University, Long Beach. A web application written in Java EE 6 that provides a centralized place to share, discuss, and discover recipes with like minded peers.
